2123168870429274123.en_summary: BREAKING: Anthropic, $ANT, has priced its IPO at $83 per share, above its marketed range of $70 to $78, per Bloomberg. The company is now expected to raise at least $68 billion through its IPO, plus another $26 billion in a private placement. Total offering more than $94 billion, surpassing SpaceX’s record $86.2 billion IPO. Largest IPO in stock market history.
2123168870429274123.zh_summary: 突發：Anthropic，$ANT，已將其 IPO 定價為每股 83 美元，高於其市場推廣範圍 70 至 78 美元，據彭博。公司現預計通過 IPO 至少籌集 680 億美元，再加上私人配售的 260 億美元。總發行超過 940 億美元，超越 SpaceX 6 月創紀錄的 862 億美元 IPO。這標誌著股市歷史上最大的 IPO。

ticker_notes.ANT: IPO 價83美元，總籌資超過940億美元，史上最大IPO
